verdict.rationale: Rollbar's own docs show a per-version view of which code versions are throwing exceptions, and deploy tracking ties errors to releases. That roughly covers the 'new issues per release' part of the story. Nothing in the evidence describes dashboards, cross-project or team rollups, top-regression views, or volume-over-time charts. The Metrics API tag is only a developer building block and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented dashboards, cross-project/team aggregation, top-regression reporting, volume-over-time trend charts, independent corroboration.
